reuse.why: Calls the existing shared getScheduledAmount, which already decides missing, single and ranged amounts by the worst-case rule.

duplication.why: No logic is re-written; the field is one call to the shared helper.

placement.why: Added in scheduleModel.toExternal in server/api-models.ts, where the API's schedule shape is built.

scope.why: Type field, one mapping line and a release note.

maintainability.why: The API field follows any future change to getScheduledAmount automatically; the only nit is typing an always-present field as optional.
